written, and which did not exist in this repository.
HOW A MISSING FILE SURVIVED: nothing read it. `pnpm typecheck` and
`next build` compile apps/web with apps/web/tsconfig.json, which maps
@ecowoods/shared through `paths` and never consults the package's own
tsconfig. So the app built, every guard passed, and the broken extends sat
there invisibly — until a file inside apps/web imported @ecowoods/shared
into a graph that vite/esbuild transforms (the booking availability test),
at which point tsconfig resolution walked into packages/shared and threw
The options below are the intersection of what the workspace already uses
(apps/web and packages/ui agree on all of them), so adopting the base
changes no compilation semantics for anything that compiles today.
`composite` and the output paths stay in the package config that sets them.
